card.name: The word to after feeling adjectives
card.fires_on: The infinitive marker "to" right after an emotion or evaluation word such as excited, glad, proud, surprising or good, or after a verb like forcing or causing. It is general web prose, not label text.

modes.label: After feeling words
modes.description: "to" follows an adjective of emotion or judgment, then a verb like see, find or note.
modes.example: I’m glad<< to>> see. Though his words continued to

modes.label: After causing verbs
modes.description: "to" follows a verb or object that forces or causes someone to act.
modes.example: forcing the military<< to>> accept their desire for change.

card.writes: It slightly favors words like "almost" and "attempt to" and disfavors words like "sooner" and "as soon as possible".
card.plain: It fires on the little word "to" after phrases like "glad to" or "surprising to", just before a verb.
